title: CROPPED OUTWORKER SHACKET - HABITAT BLUE COTTON CAMBRIC WITH ECRU EMBROIDERED PENCIL STRIPES
desc: A riff on our winter staple Outworker silhouette with a cropped length and straight hem for ease of summer wear. This textile idea came from Ankit, our primary manufacturing partner in Jaipur. On first glance this fabric mimics a classic pencil stripe poplin, but when you look closely you can see that each stripe is actually a single needle running embroidery stripe. Each stripe is done one at a time - a highly time consuming process - to add dimension and life to an otherwise ordinary cloth. The end result is subtly stunning. Proudly made in India. This garment runs true to size.
